name: io.github.slavosckie/oskkee
title: Oskkee
description: Indian creators: free INR rate estimates and audience checks; search with your Oskkee account.

tools.name: estimate_rate
tools.description: Estimate what an Indian Instagram or YouTube creator charges per deliverable, in INR, from their follower count and (optionally) average likes, comments, views and niche. Returns a price per product (Reel, Story, post, package; or YouTube integration, dedicated video, Short) when engagement figures are given, a low-high range when they are not, and the method behind it either way. Uses only the numbers you pass in: it looks nothing up. Accounts below the minimum scale are not priced, and the answer says why.

platform.description: Where the creator posts. Instagram or YouTube.

followers.description: Followers on Instagram, subscribers on YouTube.

avg_likes.description: Average likes on recent posts or videos. Without it the answer is a range, not a price.

avg_comments.description: Average comments on recent posts or videos.

avg_views.description: YouTube only: average views on recent videos. Engagement on YouTube is measured against views, not subscribers.

niche.description: What the creator posts about, in a few words (e.g. "beauty", "personal finance", "tech reviews").

tools.name: check_creator
tools.description: Check a social media creator's audience for authenticity signals before working with them: follower quality, engagement patterns, comment authenticity, growth and posting cadence. Returns an authenticity score (0-100) with the signals behind it and a link to the full public report. Works for Instagram best; YouTube, TikTok and X are read from public data where available. Accounts too small to judge get no score, by design. This is a signal check, not a ruling: "Flagged for review" means look closer, and it is not grounds to call a creator fake. Checks are limited per day; a recent check of the same account is reused for free.

handle.description: The creator's handle, with or without @, or a link to their profile.

platform.description: Where the account is. Ignored when a profile link is given: the platform is read off the link.
